data.name: BMX CITY RUN
data.detailed_description:
BMX CITY RUN is an action-packed cycling experience where skill, style, and control define your journey. Travel across diverse locations, master challenging terrains, and perform high-risk stunts to earn points, unlock new bikes, and prove yourself as an elite rider.

Each environment brings a new challenge, from dense city streets and rooftops to amusement parks and hazardous experimental zones.

🚴 Extreme BMX Gameplay
Experience realistic bike physics that demand precision, balance, and timing. Every jump, landing, and trick matters as you push for perfect runs.

🌆 Diverse Open Locations
Explore a variety of detailed environments including urban districts, parks, rooftops, and unexpected high-risk areas, each designed for unique stunt opportunities.

🎨 Character and Bike Customization
Create your own rider and personalize outfits, while also upgrading and customizing your bike with different parts, colors, and performance styles.

🎯 Missions and Challenges
Complete location-based objectives that test your stunt skills, exploration ability, and control under pressure.

🛒 Unlockable Bikes System
Earn points through tricks and missions to unlock new BMX models, each offering different handling and performance characteristics.

⚡ Skill-Based Progression
Improve your riding abilities, master complex tricks, and build your reputation as you progress through increasingly difficult challenges.

BMX CITY RUN delivers fast-paced stunt cycling gameplay where creativity and control turn every ride into a performance.
